findings.evidenceJa: 校舎はとたんに静かになった
findings.governingReading: the school building suddenly became quiet
findings.explanation: A sudden completed transition to silence becomes gradual diminishing noise.

findings.highlight: wait for her to come after her club activities
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が部活から帰ってきた後、折を見て切り出すべき
findings.governingReading: after Sakura returns from club, I should choose the right moment to broach it
findings.explanation: Waiting replaces the actual plan to raise the subject at an opportune moment.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜と藤ねえを説得する
findings.governingReading: convincing Sakura and Fuji-nee
findings.explanation: Sakura herself is omitted from the people Shirou knows he must persuade.

findings.highlight: I can’t be distracted by money during the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 生活費まで気にしだしたら聖杯戦争なんて出来たもんじゃない
findings.governingReading: if I start worrying even about living expenses, conducting the Holy Grail War will be impossible
findings.explanation: A practical incompatibility is softened into mental distraction.

findings.evidenceJa: 上等な鱈
findings.governingReading: fine-quality cod
findings.explanation: Quality is replaced by unsupported freshness.

findings.evidenceJa: 鍋物
findings.governingReading: a hot-pot dish
findings.explanation: The planned communal Japanese dish is changed to stew.

findings.evidenceJa: 一刀のもとに斬り伏せた
findings.governingReading: cut me down with a single stroke
findings.explanation: The precise overwhelming action is generalized to its near-fatal result.

findings.evidenceJa: 今にも泣きそうな顔
findings.governingReading: a face that looks ready to cry at any moment
findings.explanation: Imminent tears are generalized to sadness.

findings.highlight: No. Emiya is my last name
findings.evidenceJa: 今の発音だと『笑み社』じゃないか
findings.governingReading: with that pronunciation it becomes “smile shrine,” Emiya-shiro
findings.explanation: The missegmentation pun explaining Illya’s pronunciation error is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 発音があまりにもキテレツだった為、ついつっこみを入れてしまった
findings.governingReading: because her pronunciation was so bizarre, I reflexively retorted
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic astonishment and involuntary retort are neutralized.

findings.highlight: she can also become a ruthless Master
findings.evidenceJa: 冷酷なマスターの貌になる
findings.governingReading: her expression abruptly becomes the face of a ruthless Master
findings.explanation: The immediate visible transformation in Illya’s face becomes a generic capacity or identity.

findings.highlight: nor do I mind going ahead with my plans
findings.evidenceJa: 予定がちょっと早まるだけ
findings.governingReading: it only brings my schedule forward a little
findings.explanation: Illya’s threat that Shirou and Saber will simply die earlier than planned becomes awkward acquiescence to proceeding.

findings.highlight: what she means by “all this time”
findings.evidenceJa: 何が“それぐらい”なのかわからない
findings.governingReading: I do not know what she means by “at least that much”
findings.explanation: Shirou’s confusion is attached to the wrong preceding phrase.

findings.highlight: she wouldn’t hesitate to make herself heard
findings.evidenceJa: 全力でイリヤの申し出を拒否する
findings.governingReading: she would reject Illya’s proposal with all her strength
findings.explanation: Saber’s hypothetical decisive refusal is replaced with merely voicing herself.

findings.evidenceJa: 無謀で無策で無考
findings.governingReading: reckless, planless, and thoughtless
findings.explanation: The three distinct failings lose the absence of any plan and duplicate recklessness instead.

findings.highlight: I wanted to talk with you
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤとは会って話がしたかった
findings.governingReading: I wanted to meet Illya and talk with her
findings.explanation: Shirou’s reciprocal wish to see Illya, not merely converse, is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 舞うように走り出す
findings.governingReading: Illya takes off running as though dancing
findings.explanation: The light visual character of Illya’s movement disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 人をぶった斬っておいて
findings.governingReading: after cutting me down
findings.explanation: Illya’s near-bisection of Shirou is weakened to a generic attack.

findings.evidenceJa: 好き嫌いの話
findings.governingReading: talking about likes and dislikes
findings.explanation: The mutual, general topic is narrowed to Shirou liking Illya.

findings.evidenceJa: びくり、と肩を震わせて
findings.governingReading: Illya’s shoulders give a start
findings.explanation: The visible recoil is rendered in malformed English.
